coordinateSystem: right-handed, Y-up, metres; forward = +Z; right = forward x up = -X when facing +Z

models/hero-boat.glb.source: fal tripo3d/h3.1/image-to-3d (request 01a1bc71-ee6a-74b0-8a3f-eb0021277fca) from fal-ai/nano-banana-pro/edit isolation (01a1bc70-bfd4-7ec3-8e62-b4d7bb1731b5) of the original gameplay image + vehicle sheet
models/hero-boat.glb.processing: production/blender_normalize.py: rotate +90deg Z (bow -> +Z), scale to 3.8 m length, waterline origin (hull bottom -0.42 m), textures resized to 2048/1024 WEBP
models/hero-boat.glb.collider: circle radius 1.05 m (TUNING.hullRadius) in the XZ plane

models/driver.glb.processing: rotate -90deg Z (face -> +Z), seated height 1.18 m, origin at boot soles, decimate 0.55, head split (top 30%) as node 'driver_head' re-pivoted at neck at runtime

audio.audio/engine-loop.mp3: elevenlabs/sound-effects/v3 loop=true 8 s; pitch follows throttle+speed
audio.audio/river-loop.mp3: elevenlabs/sound-effects/v3 loop=true 10 s; constant low bed
audio.audio/course-music.mp3: fal-ai/elevenlabs/music 75 s instrumental, looped on the music bus

procedural.sandstone cliffs: upper/background tiers only: instanced chamfered blocks + world-space strata shader (src/world/canyon.ts); river-facing tiers use the fal module
procedural.foliage/flowers/trees/vines: boulders procedural; bank plants, flowers, vines and trees are fal painted cards
procedural.water/foam/wake/spray: river shader: 4 directional Gerstner-style waves (analytic normals, downstream travel), fbm micro-ripples, Schlick sky reflection, sun sheen + glints, Voronoi lace bank foam, fbm whitecaps, streaky rapid/cascade whitewater, foam rings at rocks, speed-scaled hull collar; wake ribbon with lacy arms + cellular bubbles; pooled foam-clump/droplet spray

textures/plants.webp.layout: 4096x3072, 4x3 cells: broadleaf fern flowerbush vine / reeds palmlet bougainvillea elephantear / hibiscus fernflower agave vinecurtain
textures/plants.webp.source: 3 Nano Banana Pro sheets -> BiRefNet v2 alpha -> packed by production script (layout json production/fal/outputs/atlas-layout.json)

textures/trees.webp.layout: 3072x2048, 3x2 cells: acacia roundtree palm / jungletree gnarled
textures/trees.webp.source: 2 Nano Banana Pro sheets -> BiRefNet alpha

cliffKit.lod: each has *-lod.glb (350 tris, geometry only, reuses the full piece material); full pieces ~1500 tris
cliffKit.convention: unit 1x1x1 m, base y=0, eroded FRONT faces local +X; native [depth, height, along] proportions recorded in src/main.ts CLIFFS for shape-aware random choice
cliffKit.processing: production/blender_kit.py unit <tris>; Tripo H3.1 detailed geometry from Nano Banana Pro concepts guided by original cliff crops
cliffKit.runtime: instanced per piece per 120 m chunk; near/far LOD swap at 170 m (high) / 110 m (low); random mirroring; distant mesas always full detail

rockKit.convention: uniform scale, largest footprint 1 m, base y=0; normals auto-checked outward at load
rockKit.runtime: albedo lifted/warmed in engine (Tripo baked dark slate blue); slalom rocks scaled to collision radius; shore, funnel, cascade and rapid-edge rocks randomly mixed

randomness: Scenery seed random each page load (?seed=N to reproduce). Seed drives cliff piece choice/mirroring/sizes, bank biomes (lush, flowering, reedy, dry), plant/tree/rock mix, tints and mirroring. Gates, tokens, slalom rocks, ramp and colliders are fixed for fair play.
